## About
Mr. Jiffy Sticker is a small business on Louetta Rd in Spring, TX, where getting your car inspected is about as easy as it gets. You pull up, stay in your seat, and you're back on the road before you know it.
Reviewers keep coming back to the same things: quick, kind, and efficient service with no upselling. On a hot day, you'll probably be handed a cold bottle of water for the road, too.
Some customers have been coming here for years. If you need an inspection or an emissions test, stop by and see why.

## Services
- Inspection: A quick, efficient inspection while you wait in your car.
- Emissions test: Emissions testing done fast, without leaving your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: How long does an inspection take?
A: Reviewers say they were in and out in about 10 minutes.

Q: Do I have to get out of my car?
A: No. Customers say they stayed in their vehicle the whole time.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: We're open Saturday from 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM and closed on Sunday.
